timing_definitions.training_time_avg_ms: mean wall time of model.fit on one oversampled training fold
timing_definitions.prediction_latency_per_sample_ms: wall time of model.predict on one unseen test fold divided by its row count, averaged over folds (batch of 1-5 rows, so it includes per-call overhead)
timing_definitions.fit_time_total_ms: Isolation Forest fit on the whole batch
timing_definitions.total_execution_time_ms: whole ml_detector.py run including loading, all evaluations and I/O

ground_truth.label_definition: label = 1 if the generator logged the action as not authorized (authorized = 0/no)

dataset_summary.ground_truth_method: Scenario/action record (infrastructure/extracted_handoff/ot_telemetry_handoff_2026-11-04/scenario_file.csv): 1 = action logged as not authorized, 0 = authorized action

unsupervised_models.intended_purpose: Batch outlier screening of the current capture (fit and score on the same batch; not evaluated as a detector of new observations)

rule_baseline.note: Applied to every labelled event; no training data needed.
